message: 第五の魔将
Oh, an unusual pair.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Ah, you mean Ode-yan?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ode-yan?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Yeah, Oderek. Foreigners have weird names that are hard to remember, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is his reputation like?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Word is he's a hard worker. Though his one flaw is that he sneaks a bite every now and then, apparently. He ought to just call it taste-testing.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so...」
Azel was worried the Student Council would be held responsible if Eauderourke caused any trouble, so she came to check up on how he was doing.

name: Azel
message: 「Is he facing any discrimination?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Ryuusei Town's always had plenty of foreigners, so no.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see...」
I get it. She's genuinely worried about Eauderourke too.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Anyway, Azel-chan. Forget about that--」

name: Synn
message: 「Auntie. Azel. Hello.」

name: Azel
message: 「W-Why are you here?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shopping. Auntie, I'll take this cabbage.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Coming right up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Looks like you're pretty close with Auntie.」

name: Azel
message: 「That is not particularly the case.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「What are you talking about? We're close enough to buy and sell, take photos and be photographed! I am a beauty, after all! Ohohohohohohohoho!」
There were quite a few photos taken of Shina-oba, though I doubt that's the reason.

name: Azel
message: 「...That is not why. It is merely because you are amusing.」
Thought so.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「So, by the way, Synn-chan. How've things been lately?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lately? Exams just ended, so now it looks like I'll be busy getting ready for the Holy Night Festival coming up.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「None of that matters! More importantly, have you made any progress with Nanaka-chan?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nanaka? Is there something going on between Nanaka and this guy?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Hehe. Looks like you're interested, Azel-chan. Actually, these two--」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Auntie. Nanaka and I are just childhood friends. There is noooothing going on like what you're hoping for!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Same old story as always. Poor Soba.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Not what I was hoping for, but just what I expected, huh. Good grief.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「So he says, Azel-chan. I feel bad for Nanaka-chan, but I'm an apostle of truth, after all! I'll be keeping an eye on how things develop.」

name: Azel
message: 「Feel bad? Develop?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Auntie. I'd love to listen a little longer, but I've got errands to run!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「One extra-large, coming right up!」
A lively voice echoes out from inside the beef bowl shop.
Azel readies a digital camera and snaps a photo of Eauderourke hard at work.

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like he's doing his best.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not worried about a demon.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's the truth!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Sally-chan, you shouldn't be slacking off from work.」

name: Sally
message: 「No, I'm not! The Boss said these are on the house for you two.」
Three piping-hot beef bowls are held out in front of us.
They're piled so generously that the lids are pushed right up.

name: Azel
message: 「Could it be... did he make these?」

name: Sally
message: 「That's right! The Boss is pretty handy! Hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh. There's one for yours truly, too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you! Tell Eauderourke thanks for us too, okay?」

name: Sally
message: 「Your stomach's growling! Starving, starving!」

name: Synn
message: 「Since it's about time, want to grab lunch?」

name: Azel
message: 「M-My stomach is not--」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Azel
message: 「Munch, munch, chomp, chomp, gobble, gobble. Yes. Delicious. So good!」
Azel is eating with such gusto it looks like she might bury her face right in the bowl.
It's already past mid-November, but on a sunny day like this, it's not cold even sitting side by side on a park bench.

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to rush so much, the beef bowl isn't going to run away.」

name: Azel
message: 「Chomp, chomp, munch, gobble, nom, nom. You eat properly too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I am eating.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, this is good.」

name: Azel
message: 「Delicious! How utterly delicious! Ah, how I have fallen... yet it is delicious! How seductive human food culture is. Delicious, delicious!」
In no time at all, our beef bowls are empty. Our stomachs are full.

name: Azel
message: 「Whew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the meal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Thanks for the food.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Haaah.」

name: Azel
message: 「That was good.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「So food is delicious even when made by Demons.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Eauderourke is working really hard at it, after all. He's improving fast too.」

name: Azel
message: 「That is not what I.」

name: Azel
message: 「No... perhaps that is it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just had a thought, though. The reason both Auntie Shina and Tame-san accepted Eauderourke and the others so easily is.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're just laid-back.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, isn't it because Demons used to work like this in the past too? Maybe that memory still lingers somewhere.」

name: Synn
message: 「If the whole world became like Ryuusei Town, we wouldn't have to fight demons anymore.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then the Crusaders would be out of a job.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we could help demons in trouble, or help solve problems between demons and humans.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't sound like there's any money in it, as usual.」

name: Azel
message: 「Perhaps what you said before may be true.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「You said that humans, angels, and demons are all the same.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I still think so.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet, perhaps that is precisely why conflict will never end...」
I felt like that murmur wasn't directed at me, but inward, toward Azel's own heart.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」
A weight resting on my shoulder.
Before I knew it, Azel had leaned her head against my right shoulder and fallen asleep.

name: Paqy
message: 「She's pretty cute when she's like this, ain't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's always cute.」
A pleasant warmth spreads from my shoulder.
Azel sure is light.
And warm, too.
Even when I try not to look at her face resting right beside me, I end up looking anyway.
She really is cute.
She smells nice, too.
Do all girls smell this nice?

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama. Twitching your nose and sniffing like that--you've got quite the fetish.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not doing that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Keep your voice down or you'll wake her up. What's wrong with having a scent fetish anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everything.」
As we argued in hushed voices, a shadow suddenly fell over us.

name: Melphas
message: 「My, what a rare sight. Lately, nothing but unusual things have been happening--Seven Demon Generals working part-time at beef bowl shops or as waitresses. Myself included.」
When I raised my head, there stood the demon who had previously introduced himself as Melphas.
According to Paqy, he's supposedly stronger than Eauderourke.

name: Melphas
message: 「You there, the Student Council President. Charming as ever, I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a guy.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Before beauty and charm, differences in gender or race are trivial matters.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you need something?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I was simply captivated by this rare sight and let a few words slip out unintentionally, so there is no need to be so on guard.」
How am I supposed to handle this?
This guy is a demon at least as powerful as Eauderourke, if not more.
I don't even know if Melphas is his real name.
Judging from what Arden said the other day, he might actually be Bylous himself.
Should I call everyone over?

name: Melphas
message: 「What an adorable sleeping face. It is no wonder your heart skips a beat, Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't wake them up.」
Still, I can't drag Azel into danger.

name: Melphas
message: 「Understood. Even so, with so many unusual events occurring one after another, perhaps a so-called miracle might just happen as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「A miracle?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Though, of course, once it actually happens, it is no longer a miracle.」

name: Synn
message: 「Who are you, really?」

name: Melphas
message: 「A worshiper of love, beauty, and fascination.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh dear, I was under the impression that you and I shared a rather memorable, fateful encounter, Student Council President. Was that merely my imagination?」

name: Melphas
message: 「My name is Melphas. Please do remember it from here on.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you Bylous?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Good grief, to be mistaken for the one known as the Chief of the Seven Demon Generals! There may be those who would be delighted by the mix-up, but I am not pleased at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... Bylous isn't popular with women or something?」

name: Melphas
message: 「No. He is actually quite the handsome, gentle-featured man. In fact, despite having no intention of doing so, he causes quite a stir among the ladies.」

name: Melphas
message: 「However, he pays no mind to the flowers blooming all around him. And that is a way of life I wish to stay as far away from as possible.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Are you one of the Seven Demon Generals too?」

name: Melphas
message: 「It seems there are occasionally those who refer to me as such.」
I knew he was a strong demon, but to think he was actually a Demon General!

name: Synn
message: 「If you're one of the Seven Demon Generals, then someday you and we will...?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Though this may be a rude question, are you, Mr. Student Council President, the sort of man who forces his will upon women through violence or words?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way.」

name: Melphas
message: 「In that case, there will likely be no battle between you, Mr. Student Council President, and myself.」

name: Melphas
message: 「For my fists shall only ever be raised against you should you harm, defile, or bring shame upon any of the lovely women I so dearly adore.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Though it would be another matter entirely if you were to attack me like the demons who target me to make a name for themselves, or certain dogmatic angels.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat!? There are angels like that too? Since they're angels, I thought they were all pacifists.」

name: Melphas
message: 「No, no. Just as there are all kinds of demons and humans, there are all kinds of angels as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I guess that's true.」
In that case, that means he has no reason to fight us Crusaders.

name: Synn
message: 「...It doesn't look like we'll be fighting you, then.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Splendid. After all, I have no wish to fight a charming Student Council President such as yourself either.」

name: Melphas
message: 「If I had the spare time for such things, I would much rather enjoy a pleasant moment with a lovely lady.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh my. If I monopolize you any longer, Mr. Student Council President, I fear she will grow cross with me. Now then, farewell.」

name: Melphas
message: 「May fortune smile upon your future.」
It kind of feels like he got the wrong idea.
Even though Azel and I don't have that kind of relationship.

name: Synn
message: 「Good morning.」
Azel looked at my face with a dazed gaze, and

name: Azel
message: 「Hah!?」
She bolted upright like a coiled spring and stood up from the bench.

name: Azel
message: 「I-I was not sleeping!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, isn't that... a bit of a stretch?」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't tell anyone.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you say so, then fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「It was cute.」

name: Azel
message: 「F-Forget it!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Until we meet again. Arden.」

name: Arden
message: 「D-Dammittttt! Someday I'll get youuuuuuuuu.」
Gradually, Arden's presence grows smaller--

name: Arden
message: 「Pa-s-ta-cha... n...」

name: Soltia
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why isn't he... fighting...?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Who knows.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Still, are you sure about this? I don't think Bylous stands a chance against the Crusaders, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I was merely wondering.」

name: Soltia
message: 「It might be better for you that way, too. If Bylous loses to the Crusaders, you'll be the one who has to fight them.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Though I wonder if you can even fight them?」

name: Azel
message: 「...If my master.」

name: Azel
message: 「...So wishes it.」
